meta.title: Action Tag — Laser Tag Equipment Developer & Manufacturer | UK
meta.description: We develop and manufacture professional laser tag equipment in the UK and EU since 2004. MK14 taggers, wireless sensors, MilSim KillHouse systems and full support for rental businesses.

hero.title: Professional laser tag equipment, built for the toughest rental business use
hero.subtitle: A reliable tool of the trade for field operators — designed by a team that runs laser tag sites, not just a factory.

items.title: Industry pioneers
items.text: First to market with wireless head sensors in 2006 and the laser tag pistol in 2008. PC interface, multicolour team LEDs — we built them first.

items.title: Made in UK & EU
items.text: Our production and warehousing facilities are located in the UK and EU. Short lead times, real support, no grey imports.

items.title: Built for rental
items.text: Weapons-grade ABS bodies, 36-hour battery life, one-kilo full-size taggers that fit kids and adults alike. Equipment that earns, day in and day out.

items.title: We hold your hand
items.text: Full demo, site design help, game scenarios, staff training and support afterwards. Buy, rent or lease — we make starting easy.

devices.subtitle: Play sets compatible with each other and with every prop we sell

props.title: A complete gaming ecosystem
props.subtitle: Props and accessories that turn a field into scenarios players come back for

milsim.title: MilSim KillHouse
milsim.text1: The only electronic shooting range in the world that works with paintball, airsoft and laser tag equipment. Inspired by the CQB training facilities used by law enforcement and special forces.
milsim.text2: Electronic targets connect to a scoring system: eliminate them all along the course, stop the timer, beat the best time. Single firing position or an obstacle course up to 60 metres with 24 targets — competitive, adrenaline-packed and endlessly replayable.

business.title: Start your laser tag business
business.subtitle: You do not need as much outlay as you might think. We have several ways to get you running:

options.title: Buy
options.text: Straightforward ownership with warranty support that can be extended. Add more equipment at any time — everything stays compatible.

options.title: Rent
options.text: Get the newest equipment without being tied to ageing kit. Return or swap when your needs change.

options.title: Lease
options.text: Spread the cost while your site earns. Upgrade paths keep you ahead of local competitors.

business.footer: Every option comes with a full demo, training, site-design guidance and our know-how in attracting clients.
